ruling.recommended_action: Issue a $7.54 voucher (RydeTAXI metered-fare overcharge for the un-exempt detour segment) and record the RD-1 violation on the driver's file; no account flag (no upheld dispute in the last 90 days).
ruling.reasoning:
Safety screen: the chat [F8][F9], the driver's statement [F11] and the complaint contain no threat, intimidation, harassment, sexual remark, abuse or dangerous-driving allegation — nothing to escalate; safety_concern = none.

Route deviation: one off-route segment, F3 21:26–21:37, 6.64 km driven where the optimal route covers 1.76 km, +4.89 km, straying up to 2,070 m from the optimal route. Evidence is complete (GPS, timeline, fare, both chat messages timestamped, F10), so evidence_status = sufficient, no gap.

Do the rider's words cover it? RD-4 first: F12 shows Central Expressway speed band 2 (10–19 km/h) — but the band window is 21:06–21:26, i.e. it closes before the segment begins at 21:26, and F15 records no traffic incident on the route. RD-4(b) is therefore at most corroborative and cannot exempt alone (G3), and RD-4(c) sends the segment to RD-2.

RD-5: rider consent [F9] at 21:24 predates the segment start 21:26 — timing satisfied. But the scope of the words is the question. The rider only said “Can lah, go ahead.” to Balestier Road. Reading the record: the segment ran 21:26–21:37 covering 6.64 km with a maximum deviation of 2,070 m from the optimal route; the only Balestier-area traffic fact is BRADDELL ROAD (category 2, band 5, 40–49 km/h) [F14], and Balestier itself appears nowhere; the driver's own statement [F11] merely repeats that he asked via Balestier Road. Nothing in the record ties the driven 6.64 km/2,070 m excursion to Balestier Road (no stop on it, no location message, no road-name fact), and nothing places the segment elsewhere either. Per RD-5 + G13 that is not “named_road_tied” but “named_road_untied”, hence the finding for F3 is undetermined — the rider's agreement to a named road is not shown to cover the segment actually driven. Note also that a driver's post-trip statement of verbal consent is not consent (G11) and cannot fill that gap.

Amount: RydeTAXI bills by the meter, so detour distance directly enters the fare. The rider's own words do not pin the segment to the agreed road, so the un-exempt distance is the recorded excess 5.35 km × this trip's per-km rate $1.4098 = $7.54, exactly the excess-distance line billed [F4] (un-exempt segment extra_km 4.89 km would yield $6.89; the billed excess is the larger and is the rider's actual overcharge). The 0.4 min waiting charge $0.11 [F5] is meter waiting time on a RydeTAXI and is not refundable (RD-3(c)); base/time/platform components and the 1.0× surge [F6] are unaffected.

Because the undetermined finding changes the amount, this case is not for a flat no_action; the payable figure rests on the recorded fare fact F4, so I rule refund_partial of $7.54 and recommend a human reviewer confirm the segment-to-road correspondence. RD-6 does not apply: neither F17 nor F18 shows any upheld dispute in 90 days, so no flag_account.

segment_findings.reason: Rider's message [F9] at 21:24 agreeing to “go round via Balestier Road” predates the segment start 21:26, so timing is satisfied, but the record contains nothing tying the 6.64 km / max 2,070 m deviation to Balestier Road — no stop there, no location message, no road-name fact (the Balestier-area fact is Braddell Road [F14]), and nothing places the segment elsewhere either. RD-5 + G13: the agreement to a named road only covers driving on that road, so the finding is undetermined rather than exempt; the driver's post-trip verbal-consent claim [F11] is not consent (G11). RD-4 cannot exempt either: the Central Expressway band-2 window [F12] ends at 21:26 before the segment and there is no incident [F15].

rejected_claims.reason: RD-5 requires a record tying the driven segment to the named road; none exists (G13), and the observed 6.64 km / 2,070 m deviation is consistent with Balestier only if one assumes it. Not exempt.

rejected_claims.reason: Speed band 2 covers 21:06–21:26, ending before the segment begins 21:26, and no traffic incident is recorded [F15]; band facts alone cannot exempt (RD-4(b), G3).

rejected_claims.reason: A post-trip statement of verbal agreement is a claim, not consent; only the rider's own pre-detour message counts (RD-5, G11).
